framework.purpose: Convert the Round 1 near-future campaign into an executable, leakage-clean row packet that can later kill or preserve the bounded R_oe protocol without claiming R_oe exists.
framework.core_move: Treat each row as a pre-registered specimen bundle with frozen normal-state odd/even susceptibility, independently measured B_min covariates, frozen U_miss, calibration ledger, and embargoed superconducting-output labels.
non_claims: This does not claim an existing public packet exists.
This does not claim C_phi is independent.
This does not claim R_oe survives.
This does not allow retrospective montage from papers with incompatible sample histories or known superconducting outputs.

P_oe.domain: normal-state, calibrated odd/even bilayer susceptibility on the frozen q, omega, qz, polarization, temperature, and pressure grid
P_oe.units: dimensionless after chi_odd and chi_even are converted to the same susceptibility units

denominator_rule.epsilon_D: pre-frozen susceptibility-denominator floor derived only from susceptibility-channel noise, channel-mixing covariance, blank/standard residuals, and calibration uncertainty in D_oe units
denominator_rule.censoring: If abs(D_oe) <= epsilon_D, the row-cell is censored for canonical P_oe. It is not rescued by replacing the denominator.
denominator_rule.sign_rule: The sign of D_oe is retained when abs(D_oe) > epsilon_D; no absolute-value denominator is allowed for canonical P_oe.

forbidden_drift: Do not redefine P_oe as (chi_odd - chi_even) / max(abs(chi_odd) + abs(chi_even), epsilon_floor).
Do not tune epsilon_D using structural, Raman, oxygen, pressure-path, superconducting-output, or residual-collapse behavior.
Do not compare canonical P_oe numerically with L1-stabilized diagnostics without a declared mapping.

allowed_diagnostic.name: P_oe_L1_diagnostic
allowed_diagnostic.firewall: P_oe_L1_diagnostic cannot replace canonical P_oe in the primary residual call and cannot be used to choose rows, thresholds, or denominator floors after output reveal.

B_min.definition: The minimum pre-output baseline covariate block needed to absorb ordinary oxygen, structure, orbital, disorder, pressure-path, c-axis, and sample-quality explanations before testing whether P_oe has residual explanatory content.
B_min.non_tautology_rule: No B_min field may be trained on, selected by, or numerically calibrated against Tc, zero resistance, Meissner/diamagnetism, superconducting gap, critical current, superconducting spin resonance, or human labels derived from those outputs.

row_identity.row_id: opaque stable ID assigned before measurement

specimen_ids.baseline_specimen: same sample when nondestructive; sibling if destructive
specimen_ids.pressure_structural_specimen: same sample preferred; pressure-matched sibling allowed
specimen_ids.embargoed_output_specimen: same sample or designated sibling whose superconducting-output labels are sealed

grid_lock.qz_values: must include odd/even contrast-sensitive values or justified equivalents
grid_lock.polarizations: frozen incident and outgoing polarization settings where available
grid_lock.temperature_grid: normal-state only; excludes temperatures near suspected superconducting transition windows
grid_lock.pressure_grid: frozen pressure landmarks or continuous ledger bins
grid_lock.censoring_rules_hash: hash of locked censoring code and thresholds

P_oe_block.instrument_config: beamline, edge, analyzer, resolution, geometry, polarization, pressure-cell configuration
P_oe_block.P_oe: canonical value or null if censored
P_oe_block.P_oe_extractor_id: team/script ID with no access to B_min fit choices or output labels

B_min_block.B_min_extractor_id: team/script ID with no access to P_oe residuals, odd/even fit nuisance parameters, or output labels
B_min_block.B_min_freeze_hash: hash of locked covariate extraction and imputation code

U_miss_block.imputation_policy: frozen before output reveal; sensitivity analysis ranges cannot be changed after residual behavior is seen

embargo_block.normal_state_allowed: transport, optical, Raman, XRD, XAS, and spectroscopy only outside frozen output-risk windows and only if not selected using superconducting knowledge
embargo_block.unlock_condition: P_oe, B_min, U_miss, censoring flags, row inclusion, and calibration logs are frozen and timestamped

pilot_executability_floor.status: enough only to test whether the packet machinery is executable, not enough for a strong R_oe claim

primary_protocol_floor.status: minimum for a serious cross-fitted residual-collapse attempt

hard_fail: more than 35 percent denominator-censored rows in the primary grid
any pressure landmark represented by fewer than 3 valid rows

deliberate_controls: at least one oxygen-shifted control per batch
at least one pressure-path-shifted control across the packet
at least one calibration-standard repeat per P_oe acquisition run
hard_fail: only one growth batch for a primary claim
all P_oe rows acquired in one unreplicated run with no standard repeat
matched-specimen rows lack genealogy strong enough to distinguish sibling mismatch from P_oe residual

required_axes.axis_failure_rule: A row missing oxygen, pressure-path, or P_oe calibration is excluded from primary analysis; a row missing one non-core B_min axis may remain only with pre-registered U_miss inflation.

same_sample_required_when: probe is nondestructive and compatible with the pressure/temperature state
pressure path is itself the tested variable
sibling mismatch exceeds pre-registered U_miss tolerance
sibling_allowed_when: same-sample probe environment is physically unavailable
sibling genealogy, oxygen/phase mapping, pressure ledger, and U_miss bounds are frozen before output reveal
same_sample_vs_sibling.sibling_hard_fail: If sibling oxygen microtexture or phase-fraction uncertainty is comparable to or larger than the observed P_oe residual scale, the row cannot support an R_oe claim.

calibration_and_censoring.epsilon_D_freeze_time: before output reveal and before residual-collapse model fitting
calibration_and_censoring.minimum_signal_to_floor: abs(D_oe) / epsilon_D > 1 for validity; preferred > 3 for primary quantitative use
calibration_and_censoring.channel_mixing_limit: rows whose odd/even channel-mixing uncertainty changes P_oe sign are sensitivity-only unless sign instability is pre-registered as acceptable
calibration_and_censoring.raw_archive_requirement: raw spectra, calibration standards, and fit code must be retained; missing raw archive is a protocol failure for primary claims

decision_thresholds.PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE: All schema fields have plausible acquisition routes and no firewall contradiction is intrinsic, but the packet is not yet measured.
decision_thresholds.PACKET_EXECUTABLE_WHEN_MEASURED: N >= 24, at least 18 valid P_oe rows, at least 2 batches, all core axes present, output embargo intact, raw calibration archive complete, and B_min/P_oe firewall passes audit.
decision_thresholds.PACKET_NONIDENTIFIABLE: B_min requires forbidden P_oe nuisance information, pressure/qz/c-axis corrections cannot be separated, or sibling mismatch dominates residual scale even with U_miss.
decision_thresholds.PACKET_NOT_FOUND: Existing data remain component-only and cannot be converted into rows under this schema.

probe_order.principle: Acquire maximum non-output and low-damage information before high-risk spectroscopy or superconducting-output reveal; freeze extraction rules before opening labels.

ordered_steps.name: pre_registration
actions: assign row IDs and sibling-set IDs
freeze grid, row schema, censoring rules, epsilon_D derivation, U_miss buckets, output embargo list, and inclusion rules
appoint separate P_oe extractor, B_min extractor, and output custodian

ordered_steps.name: batch_genealogy_and_room_condition_baselines
actions: measure nondestructive XRD, Raman, surface/quality checks, and orientation
log dimensions, mass, and visible damage

ordered_steps.name: normal_state_B_min_covariates
actions: measure oxygen, ligand-hole, orbital/valence, structure, disorder, and ordinary c-axis proxies
perform destructive oxygen or microscopy only on pre-assigned sibling pieces
freeze B_min extraction code and missingness policy

ordered_steps.name: pressure_path_and_structural_state
actions: load pressure cells using frozen medium and geometry
record pressure markers, gradient, load/unload path, dwell time, and thermal cycles
measure pressure Raman/XRD/XAS structural markers where available
ordered_steps.output_access: no superconducting-output access; transport only in frozen normal-state windows if used

ordered_steps.name: P_oe_spectroscopy
actions: acquire qz/polarization/form-factor resolved normal-state RIXS or neutron/RIXS hybrid maps
acquire calibration standards and blind duplicate spectra
fit chi_odd and chi_even with locked model and archive raw spectra

ordered_steps.name: lock_packet
actions: freeze P_oe, P_oe_L1_diagnostic, B_min, U_miss, censoring flags, calibration logs, row inclusion, and analysis hashes

ordered_steps.name: output_reveal_for_later_residual_protocol
actions: output custodian reveals superconducting-output labels only after packet lock
residual-collapse test is run in a separate phase
ordered_steps.output_access: allowed only after lock; not part of A Round 2 evidence

A_B_independence.rule: A Round 2 did not read current-CphiPacket/B or B output files; PI synthesis was used only because it was explicitly allowed by the task.

before_packet_lock_forbidden: pressure or sample selection based on known superconducting success
human labels, file names, specimen names, or model embeddings encoding superconducting success
output_embargo.embargo_violation_result: row excluded if local; full packet failure if selection, thresholds, model choices, or inclusion rules were affected

forbidden_crossovers: B_min cannot use odd/even decomposition residuals
B_min cannot use qz/polarization/form-factor channel-mixing nuisance parameters from the P_oe fit
B_min cannot use RIXS background parameters that were optimized to improve odd/even separation
B_min cannot use P_oe residual behavior, row leverage, or sign stability to select covariates
P_oe denominator floor cannot use B_min structural/Raman/oxygen/pressure fields
P_oe row inclusion cannot be decided using B_min fit quality after residual behavior is known
allowed_interfaces: pre-registered pressure and temperature grid labels
instrument-independent metadata such as timestamp, pressure marker ledger, and specimen genealogy
raw B_min covariates acquired independently before output reveal
raw P_oe spectra and calibration files held separately until both extraction hashes are locked
B_min_P_oe_firewall.same_instrument_exception: If a B_min covariate and P_oe are both derived from the same broad instrument session, the B_min covariate must be extracted from independently defined spectral regions or standards that are not fit residuals or nuisance terms of the odd/even model; otherwise it is sensitivity-only or excluded.
audit_test: Can the B_min table be reproduced with P_oe spectra, odd/even fit parameters, and output labels hidden?
Can the P_oe table be reproduced with B_min covariates and output labels hidden?
Are denominator floors reproducible from susceptibility calibration artifacts alone?
Do row inclusion logs predate output reveal and residual analysis?
Do blind duplicates preserve row identity without letting extractors infer superconducting labels?

B_min_proxy_priority: Use direct oxygen, XRD/Raman structure, XAS/XES valence, microscopy, pressure ledger, and normal-state optical proxies first.
Use same-session RIXS-derived non-P_oe proxies only as sensitivity covariates after firewall audit.
Never use superconducting output or output-adjacent transition features as B_min.

feasibility_decision.why: A sealed packet is experimentally hard but not internally contradictory if it is designed prospectively with row identity, at least two batches, frozen grids, susceptibility-only denominator floors, independent B_min extraction, raw calibration archives, and output embargo.
feasibility_decision.current_literature_status: PACKET_NOT_FOUND for existing retrospective data: current sources supply component evidence and metrology languages, not executable rows.
feasibility_decision.executable_claim_boundary: The packet becomes executable only after the threshold table is satisfied. Until then, the allowed claim remains feasibility of a bounded protocol, not evidence for R_oe.
feasibility_decision.most_fragile_assumption: Matched siblings preserve oxygen microtexture, phase fraction, pressure path, and ordinary c-axis state tightly enough that U_miss remains smaller than the tested P_oe residual scale.
feasibility_decision.killer_test: If the B_min table cannot be produced without P_oe qz/matrix-element nuisance information, or if same-sample/matched-sibling mismatch dominates the residual scale, the packet is non-identifiable and R_oe cannot be decided by this route.

failure_modes.mode: Canonical P_oe is silently replaced by an L1-stabilized diagnostic.
failure_modes.detection: formula audit finds abs(chi_odd)+abs(chi_even) or max denominator in primary P_oe field
failure_modes.remedy: rename as P_oe_L1_diagnostic and rerun primary analysis with canonical P_oe plus denominator censoring

failure_modes.mode: epsilon_D is selected using structural/Raman/pressure covariates, B_min fit quality, or residual behavior.
failure_modes.detection: epsilon_D provenance includes non-susceptibility units or post-residual timestamps
failure_modes.remedy: derive epsilon_D only from susceptibility calibration/noise/channel-mixing/blank residuals before reveal

failure_modes.mode: B_min imports qz/c-axis/matrix-element nuisance terms from the P_oe extraction pipeline.
failure_modes.detection: B_min reproduction requires P_oe fit residuals, channel-mixing parameters, or RIXS background choices optimized for odd/even separation
failure_modes.remedy: exclude contaminated covariates from primary B_min or demote them to sensitivity-only

failure_modes.mode: Superconducting-output labels influence row selection, thresholds, covariates, pressure landmarks, or human labels before packet lock.
failure_modes.detection: timestamps, file names, lab notes, or selection logs reveal output-aware decisions
failure_modes.remedy: exclude affected rows if isolated; restart packet if design-level choices were contaminated

failure_modes.mode: Rows are too few or all from one batch/load/probe run.
failure_modes.detection: N, batch, pressure-load, or blind-duplicate thresholds fail
failure_modes.remedy: treat as packet rehearsal only; do not run claim-bearing residual protocol

failure_modes.mode: Sibling specimens differ in oxygen microtexture, phase fraction, damage, or pressure path enough to break row identity.
failure_modes.detection: U_miss sibling mismatch interval overlaps or exceeds observed P_oe residual scale
failure_modes.remedy: require same-sample rows for affected pressure states or demote to non-identifiable

failure_modes.mode: Pressure path cannot be reproduced or ledgered across probes.
failure_modes.detection: missing marker series, gradient estimate, load/unload curve, medium, geometry, or thermal-cycle ledger
failure_modes.remedy: exclude pressure row or redesign as same-sample pressure path

failure_modes.mode: Raw spectra or calibration standards are missing, preventing independent refit.
failure_modes.detection: raw_spectra_uri or calibration_files unavailable at audit
failure_modes.remedy: sensitivity-only use; reacquire for primary packet

failure_modes.mode: A required B_min axis is absent or proxy-only without pre-registered U_miss.
failure_modes.detection: row lacks oxygen, pressure-path, P_oe calibration, or output-embargo metadata; or multiple non-core axes missing
failure_modes.remedy: exclude row from primary analysis or pre-register expanded U_miss before reveal

claims.statement: A Round 2 executable schema can be defined without changing the core scientific claim: it remains a near-future packet design, not a validation of R_oe.
claims.basis: Round 1 A and PI synthesis agree existing literature is component-only and that the next step is row-level sealed packet design.

claims.statement: The canonical P_oe should remain (chi_odd - chi_even)/(chi_odd + chi_even), with denominator-floor censoring rather than denominator replacement.
claims.basis: Inspector warning explicitly identifies L1 stabilization as definition drift and requires standardization before comparison across rounds.

claims.statement: A serious primary packet requires at least 24 total rows, at least 18 valid uncensored P_oe rows after censoring, at least 2 growth batches, pressure/load replication, blind duplicates, and all core axes present.
claims.basis: This threshold is conservative enough to avoid the vague 'several rows' problem while acknowledging high-pressure nickelate metrology constraints.

claims.statement: The B_min/P_oe firewall is the decisive feasibility condition: separate scripts are insufficient unless forbidden qz, c-axis, matrix-element, and odd/even fit information cannot cross into B_min.
claims.basis: Inspector and PI synthesis both identify qz/c-axis/matrix-element leakage as the main unresolved identifiability risk.

claims.statement: The strongest feasible route is still prospective same-sample where possible and matched-sibling where necessary, with sibling mismatch explicitly represented in U_miss.
claims.basis: Round 1 A route is retained but sharpened by row identity, axis coverage, pressure ledger, and hard failure thresholds.

claims.statement: If the schema thresholds cannot be met, the correct conclusion is not a weaker R_oe test but PACKET_NONIDENTIFIABLE or PACKET_NOT_FOUND depending on whether the failure is structural or merely absent data.
claims.basis: The project's allowed claim is bounded protocol feasibility; claim-bearing residual inference requires the packet.

remaining_warnings: The N=24 and valid-row thresholds are protocol judgments, not literature-proven statistical optima.
Same-sample high-pressure P_oe spectroscopy may be physically unavailable at some facilities; matched-sibling validity then becomes the load-bearing assumption.
Ordinary c-axis coherence is intrinsically close to P_oe qz physics and may need demotion to sensitivity-only if independently acquired proxies are weak.
This file does not verify citation anchors; it intentionally focuses on schema and thresholds required by Round 2.
inspector_check.independence_statement: This A Round 2 file was generated from the explicitly allowed plan, A Round 1, Inspector A Round 1, and PI synthesis inputs. It did not read current-CphiPacket/B or any B output path.
inspector_check.allowed_claim_after_round2: LP28-CphiPacket now has an executable prospective row schema and falsifier thresholds for packet feasibility. It still has no measured packet and no R_oe validation.
